name: Whisparr Stash Bridge
description: Lets Whisparr connect to Cove through Whisparr's Stash connection. Exposes a Stash-compatible GraphQL endpoint so Whisparr can trigger Cove scans and generation tasks on import, rename, and delete.
author: binarygeek119

settings.name: apiKey
settings.description: Optional. If set, Whisparr must send this value in the ApiKey header. Leave empty to accept any key.

settings.name: defaultRescan
settings.description: When a scan is triggered, rescan files even if Cove thinks they are unchanged.
